picks.title: Saber Interactive "replaced me with ChatGPT" midway through development, but AI use is not disclosed on Steam, claims former lead writer
picks.excerpt: Former Saber lead writer Stella Sacco says she was 'replaced with ChatGPT' midway through work on the newly announced Rideshare Stimulator, whose passenger stories are its selling point. She notes the Steam page carries no AI disclosure despite the writing role being handed to a chatbot.
picks.rationale: A named credit-holder says a shipping studio swapped a core craft role for a chatbot and then left the store page silent — the sharpest live test yet of what an AI disclosure is actually worth.

picks.title: This New 24/7 Society Simulator Is Powered By Thousands Of AI-Controlled NPCs
picks.excerpt: Klang's simulation game SEED runs thousands of AI-driven characters that keep living, working and reshaping society around the clock, even after players log off. Each character carries its own knowledge graph, so memories, relationships and rumours diverge per NPC.
picks.rationale: Per-NPC knowledge graphs that keep running while players are offline is a concrete architecture for persistent world design, not another chatbot-in-a-tavern demo.

picks.title: Unreal Fest Chicago 2026: shipping real-time model inference inside games
picks.excerpt: An Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 talk on shipping real-time inference inside games, where memory footprint and runtime efficiency now matter as much as raw model quality. Practical guidance for teams putting neural models into the frame budget rather than the marketing deck.
picks.rationale: The one pick that changes tomorrow's build: it treats a model as something that has to fit the frame and memory budget, with engine-level guidance from Epic itself.

picks.title: Black Myth: Wukong sequel isn't using AI because the devs were inspired by The Odyssey and Christopher Nolan's filmmaking techniques
picks.excerpt: Game Science art director Yang Qi says Black Myth: Zhong Kui will 'steer clear of AI-generated content during the design and asset phases' — 'not out of resistance, but simply to stand our ground until the very end.' The studio frames its craft references as The Odyssey and Christopher Nolan's filmmaking rather than generative tooling.
picks.rationale: A studio at the top of the market draws the line at a specific phase — design and asset production — which is a usable policy shape, not a blanket no.

picks.title: Gamescom Dev speaker survey identifies potential impacts of AI on team structure and productivity
picks.excerpt: A Gamescom Dev speaker survey finds nearly half of respondents expect AI-assisted development to be the most significant industry trend of the next three years. Respondents point to changes in team structure and productivity rather than headcount alone.
picks.rationale: Hard numbers from working developers on where AI lands next — team shape and throughput — giving leads something to plan org charts against instead of vibes.
